exposure: multiple evidence-based strategies for optimal parenteral and enteral nutrition
outcome: postnatal growth (growth velocity, length gain, head circumference gain)
length and head circumference below 10th percentile at discharge
cohort: The study included 38 extremely-low-birth-weight (ELBW) infant survivors.
finding: Despite aggressive nutrition supplementation, all infants born SGA at birth and the majority of ELBW survivors born AGA at birth still had weight, length, and head circumference below the 10th percentile at discharge.
